verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, not a software tool or service, so running it headlessly or invoking it from a CI pipeline is a software execution-mode question that does not fit this kind of product. The evidence covers chip performance, Metal and Core ML frameworks, and third-party apps that run on the hardware. None of it shows a headless or CI mode belonging to M5 itself, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
